description: In front of you on the counter is a metal dish rack holding several colorful plastic cups, with open space on the counter to the left. The right hand reaches into the rack, grips a blue cup, lifts it out and sets it upright on the counter, then repeats by removing a red cup and placing it beside the blue one, followed by lifting out a yellow cup and setting it next in the row; the right hand then moves back toward the rack and lifts a green cup up near the camera.
